description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian stocks had the most volume, turnover, trades, delivery percentage or the largest move on a given trading day. For today's movers within one index use get_top_movers.

Returns NSE securities ranked on one trading day. `metric` is "volume" (default), "turnover", "num_trades", "deliv_pct" or "pct_change"; `direction` is "desc" (default) or "asc"; `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 25). `date` is an ISO date, by default the latest day held. `instrument_class` is "equity" (default), "sme", "fund_unit" or "all". `series` narrows to one NSE series such as EQ or BE and applies together with `instrument_class`: for an SME or bond series pass `instrument_class="all"`. A security with no figure for the metric is left out. For movers within one index on the latest session use get_top_movers.
name: get_market_ranking
title: Market ranking by day
